note: Starting vault for Salt & Ember, a fictional grill restaurant used as a test brand. Every item is invented: no real company, person, place or figure. The numbers and prices are round and illustrative only. Imported once on an empty database; edit or delete in the app afterwards.

vault.title: Brisket smoke
vault.body: The brisket smokes over oak for 12 hours before service (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Dry-aged beef
vault.body: The flat iron is aged for 30 days (illustrative figure).

vault.title: From the grill
vault.body: Bone marrow €14, flat iron steak €28, charred leeks €12, ember-baked potato €8 (round, illustrative prices).

vault.title: Tonight's special
vault.body: Rib eye from the grill with frites, €32 (illustrative price).

vault.title: Tasting menu
vault.body: A six-course fire-cooked tasting menu on Fridays in December from 19:30 (invented event).

vault.title: Supper club
vault.body: A long table in the back room on 18 December at 19:00, €60 a guest, wine extra (invented event).

vault.title: The fire
vault.body: The grill is lit at dawn and fed with oak through the day.

vault.title: Bookings
vault.body: Tables are booked on saltandember.example; the restaurant is in Harrowgate, an invented city.
